title: N61: GLD VT regime analysis — bull Sharpe +0.09, bear MDD +8.5pp, 60/62% symmetric scaling
description: GLD VT analysis across bull/bear markets (2012-2025). Bull (2040 days): Sharpe +0.09, MaxDD +5.5pp. Bear (1473 days): Sharpe -0.08, MaxDD +8.5pp. During >2% rallies: VT captures 60% of return. During <-2% crashes: VT reduces to 62% of loss. Near-symmetric (60 vs 62) confirms VT is pure volatility scaling, not directional. Inverted leverage creates mild opportunity cost during panic rallies (VT underweights when vol=high=gold up) but proportional risk reduction during crashes. MaxDD improves in B
